Zz.bar_b_note: A pleasant teal-and-cream feathered body, but it barely clears the 1.80 m ruler, and the faint end collapses into a pale lump without a readable face, which sits below the Palworld creature finish.

Bo.bar_b_note: A convincing naturalistic coyote silhouette and grounded faint poses carry it, but the plain tan coat has no rim light or elemental accent, so it reads as a stock animal rather than a hero creature.

Oy.bar_b_note: Smeary low-res ground textures, a flat sky and the muddy, plastered interior wall in row 1 sink it well below Palworld density and Valheim-class light, whatever the aftermath props do.

Jb.bar_b_note: A warm, appealing elder with a clear face and eyes and a palette that suits the Meadows; the full-body view is small and stiff but the character finish holds.

Eg.bar_b_note: The saturated navy-and-yellow pattern reads like a flat decal rather than feathers, and the faint end deflates into a shapeless blob, so it falls short of the naturalistic bar.

Wj.bar_b_note: The big dragonfly silhouette is novel, but the thin body nearly vanishes at small size and the faint mid and end barely differ from standing (wings still raised).

Iq.bar_b_note: The chrome-mirror skin under a striped blue-orange sail looks like a placeholder metal shader rather than scale, and the faint end still holds the head up, so neither the material nor the hurt read lands.

Tj.bar_b_note: The huge dark salamander body is murky in value, its crimson frills edge toward the enemy faction's reserved oxblood, and in the swimming frame the trainer appears to stand on the water surface.

Ab.bar_b_note: A mossy, well-textured shell, a clear head and grounded mass make it the most world-ready creature here, though the faint poses mostly just tilt the shell.

Rp.bar_b_note: B keeps Tanglevolt's lightning-veined fur consistent across all frames, but A floats above its shadow and swaps to a flat black-and-white material in faint mid and end, and both fall short of the owner's in-game bar.

Bt.bar_b_note: The coral crab body with a barnacled shell has a readable bulk, but the faint mid and end are nearly identical to standing and the salmon skin looks plasticky rather than shell or chitin.

Vz.bar_b_note: The same strong mossy turtle carries it, and the ridden frame sells the scale, though the rider looks tiny and perched rather than seated in a saddle.

Yk.bar_b_note: A's timber frame, stone footing and plank cap read as built, but it is still a lone thin panel against a low-poly rock, a painted mountain backdrop and a pasted water strip; B is a glowing white card.

Oe.bar_b_note: The rock-plated badger has a strong, grounded silhouette and a good fur-and-stone material mix; only the flat faint end and a small perched rider hold it back.

Cx.bar_b_note: The naturalistic dark wolf is well built, but its near-black value merges with the dark stage, the face is lost, and the trainer clips into the tail area in the hit react and faint frames.

top_changes.change: Rebuild Meadows ground and set dressing for the trainer sites and homestead: higher-resolution grass and dirt materials, real sky and atmospheric depth instead of flat backdrops, grouped prop clusters, and keyed light with soft shadows

Fix the creature faint pipeline: keep materials consistent (Rp A swaps materials), ground every pose (no floating), and give each creature a faint end that clearly lies down, head lowered, eyes closed

Replace off-style creature surfaces (Iq's chrome skin, Eg's decal pattern, Bt's plastic shell) with naturalistic scale, feather and chitin materials, add rim light, and lift the values of dark creatures (Cx, Tj) off the ground
